title: A library with a missing symbol, a missing package and a pad that does not exist
how: 3 layer lines; 2 packages: R0805 has 2 smd pads, DIP4 has 4 pads, so 4 pads and 2 smds in all;
2 symbols: RES has 2 pins and CHIP has 3, so 5 pins; 2 device sets;
the gate B of U names the symbol GONE, which is not there (PHOENIX-EAGLE-007);
the device X of U names the package NOPE, which is not there (PHOENIX-EAGLE-006);
the device of U on DIP4 connects pad 9, and DIP4 has pads 1 to 4 (PHOENIX-EAGLE-008).
